name: House Hacking Effective Rent Calculator
description: Estimate your effective personal housing cost after rent received from roommates, units or other occupants.
search_intent: Calculate effective housing cost or effective rent after house-hacking rental income.
calculation: Gross housing cost = mortgage + tax/insurance + HOA + utilities + maintenance + other costs. Effective rent income = rent received × (1 − vacancy allowance). Effective housing cost = gross housing cost − effective rent income. Annual effective cost = effective housing cost × 12. Cost offset percent = effective rent income ÷ gross housing cost × 100 when gross housing cost is positive. Effective housing cost may legitimately be negative.
limitations: This is a cash-flow planning calculation, not a complete investment return model.
Principal paydown, appreciation, taxes and transaction costs are excluded.
Rental income and vacancy are estimates.
